Qwen models are downloaded and stored separately; they are not in the software package.

1. Choose the ProjectEcho CPU/Vulkan transcribe.cpp program and Qwen3-ASR GGUF model. 0.6B has been tested; 1.7B needs separate validation.
2. Alignment offers native CPU, official Python CPU, or native Vulkan, independently of transcription hardware.
3. Native alignment needs its program and ForcedAligner GGUF. Official CPU needs python.exe and an official ForcedAligner model folder. Configure this environment separately; nothing is downloaded automatically.
4. Older CPU compatibility disables AVX2/FMA acceleration and uses the bundled generic CPU program with a native GGUF. Native and official settings are kept separately and restored when compatibility is unchecked.

Machines missing the required optimized instructions use the compatible CPU path. Vulkan still needs a compatible driver. Recording, playback and export work without models or Python. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
